trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.notes: Closed. Split into FEAT-048 Villain - Velith, FEAT-049 Villain - Vortan, FEAT-050 Villain - Nyxara. Face order unchanged: Velith, Vortan, Nyxara. Old three-villain container is retired; do not add new villain notes here.

feature.title: Villain - Velith
feature.notes: Archon Velith. Bengenia / Temple of Mist. Face one of three. Unmasked in Act 3 as smotherer, not Nyxara. Living appearance hides undeath: tall, cold, long pale hair, no veil-crown on the build plate. Undead-true: milky mist eyes, gray mouth, porcelain cracks. Optional remnant if she lives past Act 3 or the Bengenia wipe. Leftover can flood Act 7. Mid-confrontations in Act 10 / Act 12 if a body remains. Not the Act 13 last fight.

feature.title: Villain - Vortan
feature.notes: Forge-King Vortan. Constium / World Cannon. Face two of three. Generous in Act 2. Barrel aims at Fire, not the Invasion. Living appearance hides undeath: elderly short heavy dwarf-king weight, gray beard, old forge muscle. Undead-true: ash skin, ember-glass stare, stitch-cracks. Fires or is one latch short in Act 7. Hunt or spare in Act 10 if he lived. Mid-confrontation in Act 12 if a body remains. Not the Act 13 last fight.

feature.title: Villain - Nyxara
feature.notes: Nyxara the Hollow Flame. Temple of Fire / Maze Fissure. Face three of three. No living mask. Form study is the true body: no human flesh, hollow cracked anatomy, ember core. Voice leaks through Fire from Act 5. Act 7 opens the Deep Fissure; do not stage her last fight there. Single ending is Act 13 / FEAT-044 / FEAT-037: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, world scarred and standing.

set.notes: Cast lock villains are now FEAT-048 Velith, FEAT-049 Vortan, FEAT-050 Nyxara. FEAT-002 is closed. Roster mains and main-side unchanged (FEAT-027 through FEAT-036).

trackerLog.decision: FEAT-002 closed. One villain feat each: FEAT-048 Velith, FEAT-049 Vortan, FEAT-050 Nyxara. Face order Velith, Vortan, Nyxara.
